notes.title: politician simulator released!
notes.content:
Hi there,

It's been some time. Early this year I finished working on several different small games. This is one of those games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681640/politician_simulator/

a short, 5 minute game that contains funny things and audio related to the United States government and politicians in general.

this game exclusively uses the mouse and keyboard, and has very simple interactions for each scene, including, but not limited to:

* Signing a bill
* Answering the phone
* Cheating on your wife
* Drinking

notes.title: my brother lives in a canyon - coming July 2021
notes.content:
[url=https://odysee.com/@kmdodrill:c/my-brother-lives-in-a-canyon-teaser:6]Teaser trailer[/url]

hi. I've been working on this game for the past couple of months and I'm finally ready to announce it. I've created this game in Godot using Blender for modeling, Krita for concept art, GIMP for asset editing, Audacity for voice recording and music editing, and other tools I'm not remembering at the moment. All inside Void Linux. I'm extremely grateful to the open source community. This game is [url=https://sr.ht/~kmdodrill/my-brother-lives-in-a-canyon]open source[/url], licensed under GPLv3. The assets, however, are proprietary.

Please check the game out on [url=https://stormkmd.itch.io/my-brother-lives-in-a-canyon]itch.io[/url] and also go to the [url=https://mybrotherlivesinacanyon.com/]website[/url] to sign up for a one-time email when the game is released.

I'm beyond excited to share this little story with everyone in July.

Thank you to the following people:
* My family

* My girlfriend who is really sweet and is always excited when I am

* Philip Moore - for recording with me and suffering through Cuphead with me in the same day

* [url=https://samshandley.com]Sam Shandley[/url] - composed the fantastic music

* [url=https://bondreal.itch.io/]Jeremy Bond[/url] - cool guy and provided a ton of feedback

* The open source community and everyone who works on open source projects
